notes: The start screen no longer flashes an unstyled page before the sign-in screen.
The ALS coordinator can put a notice on every phone when the app opens, and can close the app for maintenance while keeping their own access.

Manila City Jail classes: their teachers sign in at the teacher portal, give work to a jail class, and mark each learner Completed, In progress or Not yet. The jail portal has a Classes tab showing it, and the RLP record follows from it.
Group chats for the jail portal, the principal and the alumni, and in every group chat you can now pin a message, react to one, and send a file.
Enrollment shows male, female and total for each grade level, in the adviser's, coordinator's and principal's portals.
Subjects now belong to the section: set them once and every teacher tagging and every learner enrolled afterwards follows from them.
The coordinator can move an enrolment appointment or delete it, and an applicant can look up their own with their reference number.
Tidier account cards, a clearer filter panel on the principal's School tab, no more overlapping notices on the sign-in screen, and deleting a section now takes its class records with it.
notes_fil: Hindi na kumikislap ang start screen bago lumabas ang sign-in screen.
Makapaglalagay ang ALS coordinator ng paalala sa bawat telepono kapag binuksan ang app, at maisasara ang app para sa maintenance nang hindi nawawalan ng sariling access.

Mga klase sa Manila City Jail: nagsa-sign in ang kanilang mga guro sa teacher portal, nagbibigay ng gawain, at minamarkahan ang bawat mag-aaral ng Tapos na, Ginagawa pa o Hindi pa. May Classes tab na ang jail portal, at dito nakabatay ang RLP record.
May group chat na ang jail portal, ang punongguro at ang alumni; sa bawat group chat ay puwede nang mag-pin, mag-react at magpadala ng file.
Ipinapakita sa Enrollment ang lalaki, babae at kabuuan bawat baitang, sa portal ng adviser, coordinator at punongguro.
Sa seksiyon na nakatali ang mga asignatura: itakda minsan at dito na susunod ang pag-tag ng guro at ang bawat mag-aaral na ie-enroll pagkatapos.
Maililipat o mabubura ng coordinator ang appointment sa enrollment, at matitingnan ng nag-apply ang sarili nila gamit ang reference number.

Mas maayos na account card, mas malinaw na filter sa School tab ng punongguro, wala nang nagsasapawang paalala sa sign-in screen, at kasama nang nabubura ang mga talaan ng klase kapag binura ang seksiyon.
